# Widget Toolkit

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/acme/widget-toolkit)](./LICENSE)

Widget Toolkit is a lightweight UI widget library for web applications. It provides accessible, themeable widgets with zero dependencies.

Use it when you need standard UI components without a framework commitment. It provides:

* Accessible widgets — keyboard navigation and ARIA labels built in
* Themeable components — CSS variables, light and dark themes
* Zero dependencies — no runtime library required

> [!CAUTION]
> Widget Toolkit is a focused component library, not a framework. It does not include state management, routing, or build tooling.

## Where to Start

1. Install with `npm install widget-toolkit`.
2. Import a widget: `import { Button } from "widget-toolkit";`
3. Render it in your app.

> [!TIP]
> See the [Component Reference](docs/components.md) for every widget and its props.
